title: Where will you save it?
instruction: Only on the device, or in the cloud? Decide by what you need.

items.text: A game you want to play on a plane without internet
items.why: On a plane you can't connect to the cloud.

items.text: A report you work on both at home and at school
items.why: You can open it from any computer.

items.text: A map for a trip to the mountains where there's no signal
items.why: Without signal the map won't load from the cloud. Download it beforehand.

items.text: Photos you want to keep after changing phones
items.why: They stay in the cloud even if you change or lose your phone.

items.text: A document you're writing with classmates at the same time
items.why: You all work on the same copy on the server.

items.text: A ticket you show on the underground
items.why: Underground there's often no signal. Keep the ticket saved on your phone.

debrief: The cloud is handy when you want your data on several devices or shared with several people. Where there's no internet, the data has to be right on the device.
